import pandas as pd
import ast
source = Path("chart.py").read_text()
tree = ast.parse(source)
data_node = next(n for n in tree.body if isinstance(n, ast.Assign) and any(isinstance(t, ast.Name) and t.id == "data" for t in n.targets))
original_data = ast.literal_eval(data_node.value)
table = pd.read_csv("table.csv")
print(table.to_string(index=False))
print("Summary:", Path("summary.txt").read_text())
print("Columns:", table.columns.tolist())
if list(table.columns) == list(original_data):
    original = pd.DataFrame(original_data)
    for col in table.columns:
        for i in range(len(table)):
            if original.loc[i, col] != table.loc[i, col]:
                print("Mismatch:", i, col, original.loc[i, col], "vs table", table.loc[i, col])
